Leather wipes clean and gives dust mites nowhere to live, the one way to make the sofa itself low-dust. Open base: "Height under furniture: 6 1/4 "" on its 6 1/4" wood legs, the open floor Andrew asked for (2026-10-25: "Sofa must have empty space bettwen like" the MORABO chaise add-on), high enough for a robot vacuum (design-review.md). The MORABO sofa's page says its Gunnared cover is a "Stationary cover." / "Non-removable cover", care "Vacuum clean." and wipe clean (Materials and care, 2026-10-25); this piece's care section was not opened, so it is taken to be the same, vacuumed rather than washed (F-66).
